breaking: useCarousel removed: Carousel is a server component without React context
CarouselDots renders <a href=#slide> links with aria-current instead of role=tab buttons
CarouselDots/Progress/Counter get the slide count by cloning: they must be direct children of Carousel or nested in plain DOM elements; CarouselDots accepts count/baseId and new slideLabel
CarouselPrevious/Next are server-rendered disabled and enabled by the client island (carousel.client.tsx, must be added to registry.json)
keyboard: arrow keys scroll the focusable viewport natively instead of a keydown handler on the root
auto-play also pauses on focus and is off with prefers-reduced-motion
draggable is accepted but does nothing (it was a no-op before)

how.en: scroll-snap and dot anchors; 1 kB island for arrows and autoplay
how.ru: scroll-snap и точки-якоря; островок 1 кБ для стрелок и автопрокрутки
